days.title: Arrival to Singapore Cruise
days.body: Singapore Cruise(Singapore) Arrival Singapore On your arrival to Singapore, a representative will assist you with transfer to board a Genting Dream cruise. Flawless facilities and superb services will impart you an incredible experience here. When stars start shining, an entire dimension of activities unfold for additional fun and frolic. After an amazing dinner, overnight stay at the cruise

days.title: KL City Tour
days.body: Singapore Cruise(Singapore) At sea On board cruise activities & Day tour of KL city tour.

days.title: Night Safari
days.body: Singapore Cruise(Singapore) - Singapore(Singapore) Ship arrives in singapore at 14:00pm After breakfast on the cruise, check-out and arrive in Singapore. You will be transferred back to your hotel. Check in and spend the rest of the day at leisure. in the evening we will move to Night Safari tour . Come close to more than 2,500 nocturnal animals from 130 species in their natural habitat. The residents of Night Safari include Malayan tigers, flying foxes, Asian elephants, tapirs, lions, giraffes, and flying squirrels. Explore trekking and walking trails, and also get entertained by the cultural shows and traditional tribal dance performances. Overnight stay at the hotel. Note- Lunch & Dinner at any indian restaurant

days.title: GARDENS BY THE BAY VISIT+ UNIVERSAL STUDIO
days.body:
GARDENS BY THE BAY VISIT+ UNIVERSAL STUDIO Enjoy your Breakfast in the morning, Today visit to one of the best destinations in Singapore; Universal studio,Gardens by the Bay. It is a nature park comprising three waterfront gardens. You can visit Supertree Grove, Cloud Forest, or Flower Dome in the park. These Supertrees are the main attraction of the gardens and have a height of around 25 meters. It’s a whole new world when you enter the park. The Gardens By the Bay is spread in an area of 101 hectares and is home to a wide variety of flora. Overnight stay in hotel.
Note- Lunch & Dinner at Any indian restaurant.

days.title: Panoramic City Tour
days.body: Singapore Panoramic City Drive After breakfast start Singapore Panoramic City Drive many places to vist. overnight stay at hotel. Note- Lunch & Dinner at Any indian restaurant.

days.title: Sentosa Island
days.body: Sentosa Tour After breakfast, you will be taken for a 7 hour Sentosa Experimental Tour. In the afternoon, you will get a transfer from your hotel to Mount Faber, where you will board a cable car to Sentosa. . With more than 10 different zones, like madame tussuads & The tour will end with Wings of Time, a night show featuring water, laser and fire effect. Once the tour ends, you will get a transfer back to your hotel. Please refer to inclusion section for activities included. Note- Lunch & Dinner at indian restaurant.

days.title: Departure
days.body: Enjoy your last morning in Singapore before checking out and being transferred to the airport, where you will depart for your destination with bags full of souvenirs and happy memories.
